title: py-tray-command-launcher settings.json
description: Schema for the settings.json configuration file

hotkey.description: Global hotkey to open the launcher

app_launcher_hotkey.description: Global hotkey to open the app launcher

history_limit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

max_output_chars.description: Maximum characters retained per output tab

batch_enabled.description: Coalesce live output chunks into batched flushes

batch_chunk_count.description: Chunks that trigger an immediate flush

batch_delay_ms.description: Single-shot flush timer delay in milliseconds

icon_cache_ttl_days.description: Number of days to cache icons (0 = no cache)
